pronunciation: sen · tih · men · TAL · ih · tee
definition: Excessive tenderness or emotion that seems foolish or insincere.
author: Herbert George Wells
quote: He seemed to me to be the victim of his own foolish sentimentality.
example_sentence: He kept the old ticket stubs out of pure sentimentality.
